title_zh: 上船前决定先完成安全讲解

scenario.label_zh: 上船前确认帆船课安全讲解
scenario.goal_zh: 表达初学者的落水担忧，并约定先核对救生衣及听完教练讲解再上船

context_zh: 初学帆船的学员在码头入口与课程教练交谈；这是虚构课程。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Are we ready to embark, or is there another briefing?

sentences.speaker: Captain Shaw
sentences.text: We have a safety briefing first. Have you sailed before?

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: No. I am worried that the boat could drift away if I fall in.

sentences.speaker: Captain Shaw
sentences.text: We will cover that situation before anyone boards. You will not be left to work it out yourself.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: I know people can drown even close to shore. Could you check my life jacket as well?

sentences.speaker: Captain Shaw
sentences.text: Of course. Come over to the fitting area, and then stay with me for the full briefing.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: All right. I will do both before I get on the boat.
